primaryTextRead.text: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: L3894–3903 says the name refers to fourteen figures and lists Jehiel son of King Jehoshaphat at 2 Chronicles 21:2 separately from Levites and other namesakes.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版の人物一覧は、歴代誌下21:2のヨシャファト王の子エヒエルを、同名のレビ人などと区別しています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The list explicitly identifies the son of Jehoshaphat in 2 Chronicles 21:2 as distinct from other Jehiels.
